rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Ah, Adel-sama! This is sudden, but
please hear about something
unfortunate that happened recently...

rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0002
rows.name:
There's an obviously suspicious cave
farther inland here in Aletta.

rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0003
rows.name:
There's a hollow in the entrance for
something to fit into, so we can't get
inside, but...

rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Doesn't it bother you,
knowing that it's there and
not being able to get in?!

rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0005
rows.name:
But I don't know of any key that would
fit that hollow.

rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0006
rows.name:
Yet surely, it'll be brim-full with
treasure. And anyone able to open it
would claim it for themselves...

rows.label: tlk70000050_02_msg0007
rows.name:
What a shame... If I sold that
treasure, I could have bought a huge
amount of food...
